> GUARDIAN X is a smart school dismissal system that uses palm-vein verification to securely identify authorized guardians before a student leaves school. It brings student management, guardian registration, teacher dismissal requests, and biometric verification together in one simple, secure platform making the dismissal process safer, faster, and more reliable.
